delta_e_76 — IMGMETRICS colordiff op

• Data kinds: lab × lab → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.delta_e_76(lab1, lab2) (to call the implementation directly, import imgmetrics; imgmetrics.delta_e_76(lab1, lab2); from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("delta_e_76"))

Usage

CIE76 colour difference — the Euclidean distance in Lab space.

Simple, but it does not match perception (especially for highly saturated blues), so it is provided only as a baseline for comparison. For practical use, delta_e_2000.

Formula: sqrt((L1 - L2)^2 + (a1 - a2)^2 + (b1 - b2)^2).

• lab1, lab2: arrays whose last axis is 3. Shapes broadcast by numpy rules (a 1-colour (3,) with an image (H, W, 3) is also fine). Pass the output of rgb_to_lab.

• Return value: float64 with the last axis dropped ((H, W) for images). 0 means identical colours. As a rule of thumb about 1 is the discrimination threshold and 2.3 is said to be the JND, but with this formula, depending on hue and chroma, the same number can look different.

• Failure (MetricContractError): the last axis of either is not 3. Finiteness of values is not checked (NaN propagates as is).
